extDescription.message: Hold a key and move the mouse to scroll – drag the page, or scroll progressively from an anchor point. No mouse click needed.

siteSwitchTitle.message: Enable or disable on this site

siteUnavailableHint.message: Firefox-internal page – or reload the page.

keysHint.message: Hold the key – or mouse button – and move the mouse. In text fields, buttons and videos it keeps its normal function.

recordHint.message: Press a key – or click this field with the mouse button you want. Esc cancels.

keyUsed.message: $VALUE$ is already used for the other mode.

hintAlt.message: Tip: tapping Alt without moving the mouse still shows Firefox's menu bar as usual.

hintTab.message: Note: outside the add-on, Tab still moves between links and fields.

hintMouse0.message: A click without moving stays a click. To select text, hold Ctrl while dragging.

hintMouse1.message: A middle-click without moving still opens links in a new tab. Firefox's own autoscroll is off for this button.

hintMouse2.message: On Windows, a right-click without moving still opens the context menu. On Linux and macOS Firefox opens it on press – use Shift+right-click there (or set ui.context_menus.after_mouseup to true in about:config).

momentumHint.message: Scrolling eases in and coasts to a stop after releasing the key; in drag mode the page keeps rolling with momentum. Mouse wheel, click or any key stops it immediately.

dragHint.message: The page follows the mouse, as if you were grabbing it.

dragFrame.message: Show a frame while the key is held

scrollHint.message: Pressing the key sets an anchor point. The page scrolls towards the mouse – even while the mouse stands still.

progressiveHint.message: – the farther the mouse, the faster

accelerationHint.message: 1 = linear; higher = finer near the anchor, much faster farther out.

gaugeHint.message: The circle around the anchor grows with the speed; the dotted ring marks top speed.

speedsHint.message: Inside out, separated by commas. The active zone is highlighted.

zoneError.message: Please enter 1 to 8 positive numbers, separated by commas.

previewHint.message: Preview on light and dark backgrounds – move the mouse over it:

welcomeTry.message: No click needed. Try it right here on this page.

welcomeToolbar.message: All settings are behind the toolbar button – there you can also change the keys or turn the add-on off for single sites.

welcomeTip.message: Shortcuts like Shift+A or Alt+← and Shift+click work as before: the mode only starts once the mouse moves.
